body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at 81e41b0f:
- scripts/copilot-live-deny.mjs makeLab() creates `adlc-copilot-livedeny-*` under TMPDIR once per leg (control, treatment, shell) and cleanup() removes only the ~/.copilot hook file, so every run leaves three lab trees (each with a git repo); scripts/test/copilot-live-deny.test.mjs runs it twice per `npm test`, leaking six.
- scripts/gemini-install-smoke.mjs creates `gemini-smoke-*` with mkdtempSync and never removes it; scripts/run-tests.mjs runs it on every full suite run.
- packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/provisionClone() mints and populates `gf-clone-*` before running candidate setup; the no-sandbox refusal from spawnCandidateCmd (or any other throw after mkdtemp, e.g. a patch write error) propagates with the clone on disk, and the caller (lib/provision.mjs) never received the path, so its destroy() is a no-op. packages/gate-fuzzing/test/isolation.test.mjs leaks one clone per run through this path.
- scripts/codex-install-smoke.mjs spawns codex with an isolated HOME and no GIT_CONFIG_* override, so the git that codex runs to clone the plugin spawns `git maintenance run --auto --detach`; the teardown rmSync has no retry. CI job codex-live-latest failed on main with `ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rmdir '.../adlc-codex-home-*/.tmp/plugins-clone-*/.git'`.
- packages/fleet/test/git-mirror.test.mjs pins gc.auto/gc.autoDetach only as -c flags inside its gitAt helper; the SHA-256 test's direct `git commit` does not go through gitAt and spawns detached maintenance before a no-retry rmSync, leaving the ENOTEMPTY teardown race open.
- packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs asserts cleanup by diffing `adlc-codex-*` names in the shared system tmpdir before and after a spawned smoke run; a concurrent process on the same host creating or removing those prefixes produces a false red.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Scripts live in scripts/ and are covered by scripts/test/*.test.mjs (`node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs`). gate-fuzzing: lib/clone.mjs (clone lifecycle, provisionClone/destroyClone), lib/provision.mjs (loop adapter), lib/sandbox.mjs (spawnCandidateCmd); tests `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing`. fleet: test/git-mirror.test.mjs drives real git; shared test helpers live in packages/fleet/test/helpers/. runner: test/codex-integration.test.mjs drives scripts/codex-install-smoke.mjs. os.tmpdir() honours TMPDIR, so a child run with a private TMPDIR makes leak checks exact. `tmp(t, prefix)` from @adlc/core/test-kit gives a per-test directory.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. copilot-live-deny records each lab root it creates and removes all of them in cleanup(), which already runs from the finally block and the SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers; a failing leg still removes every lab.
2. gemini-install-smoke removes its fixture in a finally block around the shim drive.
3. provisionClone removes the clone it minted whenever it throws after mkdtemp (clone failure, patch write error, no-sandbox refusal), then rethrows the original error; a successful return still hands the clone to the caller intact. The no-sandbox refusal stays fail-closed (it still throws).
4. codex-install-smoke passes GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE setting gc.autoDetach=false in the codex spawn env, and its teardown rmSync retries (maxRetries/retryDelay).
5. The fleet suite's hermetic git env (one shared helper) carries gc.auto=0 and gc.autoDetach=false as GIT_CONFIG_* entries so every git spawned with it, including call sites without -c flags, runs maintenance in the foreground; git-mirror.test.mjs uses it and its teardowns retry.
6. The codex cleanup test runs the smoke with a private TMPDIR and asserts that directory is empty afterwards, with a positive control that the smoke's roots are created under TMPDIR.
7. No production behaviour or CLI surface changes beyond the above; no documentation change is required (the gate-fuzzing README already states the clone is always destroyed).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 copilot-live-deny, gemini-install-smoke and codex-install-smoke leave nothing under a private TMPDIR on pass and fail paths, and git spawned under codex resolves gc.autoDetach=false. verify: `node --test scripts/test/smoke-teardown.test.mjs`
- AC2 provisionClone leaves nothing under tmpRoot when it throws (clone failure, patch write error, no-sandbox refusal) and returns an intact clone on success. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/clone-provision-cleanup.test.mjs`
- AC3 A bare `git commit` under the fleet hermetic env resolves gc.auto=0/gc.autoDetach=false and never spawns detached maintenance. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/hermetic-git-env.test.mjs`
- AC4 The codex cleanup test is independent of other processes using the shared tmpdir. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing && npm test -w packages/fleet && npm test -w packages/runner && node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs and scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs; the tmp-fixture boundary guard's directory coverage (scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs); retry behaviour of @adlc/core/test-kit tmp().
title: scripts and fixtures: remove every temp dir they create and keep git maintenance out of teardown
